about: Pinned downloads (model weights, binaries, archives) for JARVIS. Fetch and verify with jarvis/tools/fetch.py. Values come only from upstream metadata (Hugging Face API lfs.oid, GitHub release asset digests, published checksum files); nothing was downloaded to compute a hash. pip and npm dependencies are locked elsewhere.

roots.oracle-vm: /home/ubuntu/jarvis (not a default: pass --root or set JARVIS_DATA_ROOT)

not_locked.unpinned_reason: The KWS runtime wheel 1.13.8+neko.kws2 is built locally from commit 11afbd00 with two patches (scripts/wake_word/build_wake_word_runtime.ps1); there is no upstream artefact to pin and its hash exists only on D:. The stock sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 wheel is a pip dependency (jarvis/tools/requirements/jarvis-venv.txt), handled by the pip lock.
No uv version is chosen anywhere in the repo (the test image runs an unpinned 'pip install uv'). Pick a version, then pin the astral-sh/uv release asset digests here.
